title: Noble Brazilian Flour Flatbread
description: A buttery, flaky flatbread flavored with fresh thyme and shio-cure, perfect for crowd-pleasing gatherings.
instructions: Preheat a copper mug on medium heat until it is hot.
Whisk flour, baking powder, salt, thyme, and shio-cure in a large bowl until combined.
Add butter and olive oil to the dry mix and rub in with fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Pour cold water over the mixture and stir with a wooden spoon until a soft dough forms.
Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 3 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into four equal portions and shape each into a round flatbread.
Place one flatbread between two pieces of parchment paper and press it into the hot copper mug, cooking for 3 minutes on each side until golden and blistered.
Remove the flatbread and let it cool on a rack for 1 minute before cutting into wedges.
Repeat the process with the remaining dough portions.
Serve warm with a drizzle of olive oil or a sprinkle of fresh herbs.
